rules.title: Berkeley 2026 Annual General Adjustment (AGA) of 1.0%
rules.requirement: Eligible Berkeley landlords may raise 2025 permanent rent ceilings by no more than 1.0% starting no earlier than January 1, 2026, with proper notice. The 2026 AGA cannot adjust rents for tenancies that began on or after January 1, 2025 and had rents set under Costa-Hawkins.
citation_aliases: Berkeley Rent Stabilization Board AGA Order for Year 2026
rules.quoted_span: adopted the Annual General Adjustment (AGA) Order for Year 2026 which will allow eligible landlords to increase the 2025 permanent rent ceilings by 1.0% no earlier than January 1, 2026.
rules.effective_date_note: Increases allowed no earlier than January 1, 2026; Board adopted the order October 16, 2025.
rules.exemptions: Tenancies that began on or after January 1, 2025 with rents set under Costa-Hawkins are not adjusted by the 2026 AGA.
rules.coverage_conditions: Landlord must qualify under Regulation 1148 and give required notice.
rules.interaction: Local rent stabilization ordinance, with Costa-Hawkins limits on some tenancies.

unverifiable_exemptions: tenancies beginning on or after 2025-01-01 with Costa-Hawkins rent setting
landlord qualification and notice under Regulation 1148

parsed.doc_summary: Berkeley Rent Stabilization Board public notice (Oct 17, 2025) announcing the 2026 Annual General Adjustment of 1.0% (65% of CPI), effective no earlier than Jan 1, 2026, under Regulation 1148 and BMC 13.76.110.
